method.numerical: Calibration-only PCA with the first two components removed, smoothing, cosine interval retrieval, and slope-constrained subsequence DTW.
method.interpretation: Words and sentence assembly were inferred from overlapping labeled calibration matches. Numerical tools produced similarities and alignments, not novel token sequences.

limitations: Word identities, counts, and boundaries remain inferred; short words have overlapping neural matches.
ta84f22ff has the greatest count uncertainty: an additional 'it' before 'here' is plausible.
'closer' has only one labeled calibration occurrence.
